parsed.notes: Actual ratio values are not disclosed; the company states only that it was in compliance with all financial covenants as of September 30, 2026. The 2.75 Net Leverage Ratio threshold restricts certain payments, and the leverage-based pricing grid sets margins and fees; neither is a maintenance covenant, so both are excluded.
